title: The smooth trace normalized by an orientation is the unique representing counit
statement: For a prime ell, a positive-characteristic field k with ell invertible, separated finite-type k-schemes X and Y, a morphism f smooth of pure relative dimension d, a bounded constructible coefficient object M on X identified with the shifted Tate twist, a bounded constructible U on Y, and an orientation isomorphism gamma : M -> Rf^! U [sk-def-sfb-dc-upper-shriek], there exists a unique morphism t : Rf_! M -> U whose adjunct under Rf_! -| Rf^! is gamma, and postcomposition with this t gives a bijection Hom(K,M) -> Hom(Rf_! K,U) for every bounded constructible K. The orientation is necessary: without it uniqueness fails, since precomposition with -1 preserves the Hom bijections [lem-pur-geometric-point-trace-not-unique].

source.place: def-route-smooth-trace, Steps 1--4: finite smooth-purity adjunction, normalized adic reconstruction, and condensed realization of the representing counit

proof.text: Take t = epsilon_U o Rf_!(gamma), the counit transpose of gamma. Its adjunct is gamma by the inverse law of the adjunction Hom equivalence, and any other morphism with adjunct gamma equals t by injectivity of that equivalence. For each K, the map a |-> Rf_!(a) o t is the composite of the bijection a |-> a o gamma with the inverse adjunction bijection, hence bijective. This is existsUnique_trace_of_orientation for the chosen adjunction.

lean.statement: theorem existsUnique_smoothTrace (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] {k : Type u} [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)] {X Y : Over (Spec (.of k))} [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [QuasiCompact X.hom] [IsSeparated X.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] [QuasiCompact Y.hom] [IsSeparated Y.hom] (f : X ⟶ Y) (d : ℕ) (_hsm : SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f.left) (M : Dᵇc(X.left)⟦Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ⟧) (_hM : M.obj ≅ (shiftFunctor _ (2 * d : ℤ)).obj (tateTwistDerived X.left ℓ d)) (U : Dᵇc(Y.left)⟦Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ⟧) (γ : M ≅ (boundedConstructibleUpperShriek ℓ f).obj U) : ∃! t : (boundedConstructibleLowerShriek ℓ f).obj M ⟶ U, (∀ K : Dᵇc(X.left)⟦Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ⟧, Function.Bijective (fun a : K ⟶ M ↦ (boundedConstructibleLowerShriek ℓ f).map a ≫ t)) ∧ (boundedConstructibleUpperShriekAdjunction ℓ f).homEquiv M U t = γ.hom
